activity_summary: After Navarre you wrote a page of the tradesmen that is not on Sunday's list. The tailor cannot read and will not be mocked for it. The wall is a man who stands anyway. You did not finish the page, and you did not count the leaves.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the page, left it unfinished, and did not count it.

facets.activity: Wrote a page of the hard-handed men
